instruction.text: Have you memorised the continents? Find Europe.

feedback.end: For example, if you live in the UK, France or Germany, then you live in Europe.

instruction.text: Look at the map carefully. Then complete the statements about the geography of Europe.

hint.text:
The cardinal directions north, east, south and west help us orient ourselves on Earth. You can use the following mnemonic to go clockwise around the map:

Never – Eat – Shredded – Wheat
North – East – South – West
hint.sound: The cardinal directions north, east, south and west help us orient ourselves on Earth. You can use the following mnemonic to go clockwise around the map: Never, Eat, Shredded, Wheat. North, east, south, west.

atoms.b: Europe is connected to the continent of ((++Asia Africa)) in the east.
The natural border between Europe and Asia is formed by a large mountain range called the ((++Urals Moscow)).
In southern Europe you can find the ((++Mediterranean Red)) Sea.
Europe has a population of around 750 million people, with many of them living in large ((++cities villages)) like London and Berlin.
The two cities with the most inhabitants are ((++Istanbul Italy)) in Turkey and Moscow in Russia.

text: Russia and Turkey are quite special countries because they stretch across the border between Europe and Asia, meaning that they are located in both continents!

instruction.text: Look, there are so many individual countries on the continent of Europe! How many are there exactly?

feedback.end: Did you know that over 200 different languages are spoken in Europe?

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Of these over 40 countries, 27 have joined together to form a union called the European Union. This is often abbreviated to the EU.
The EU countries work closely together, adopt common laws, trade with each other and use the euro as a common currency.

b: a military alliance between 40 Asian countries
++a union between European countries that work and trade with each other

atoms.a: What is the name of the currency used in the EU?
